title: A highly efficient electrolysis system enabled by direct impedance matching between a charge migration triboelectric nanogenerator and series connected electrolysers
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05522E, Paper
Yu Deng, Qian Qin, Wencong He, Hengyu Guo, Jie Chen
A highly efficient seawater electrolysis system that establishes direct impedance matching between a charge migration triboelectric nanogenerator and series-connected electrolysers is proposed.
